API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APIUser ManagementGroup Resource Add Group
Group Resource Add Group
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/groups

Adds a new group. To learn more, see Adding Groups.

Note: This endpoint is accessible via Zscaler OneAPI only.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Group information

id
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the group

name
string
REQUIRED

Group name

idpId
int64

Unique identifier for the identity provider (IdP)

comments
string

Additional information about the group

isSystemDefined
boolean

System-defined group

Responses
​
200
201
401
403

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
